thread:
emily-po: Heads-up — planning a calibration workshop for all hiring panelists next Wed 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET. Goal is to align scoring across hiring levels, walk through the updated rubric, and run 2x 20-min mock panels. Need help with logistics: invite wording, mandatory vs recommended, room/zoom, and whether we should issue a "certified panelist" badge after completion. Thoughts?

ravi-recruiter: +1 on mock panels, those helped last time. Is this mandatory for folks who did the old training last quarter?

julia-peopleops: I think new rubric is a must — but offer a fast-track for folks who can pass a short quiz. Maybe mandatory for new panelists and highly recommended for repeats.

tom-eng: timezone note: we have folks in APAC — can we record the session and run a separate 45-min recording walk-through for them? Also recommend a 60-min main session with breakout rooms for the mock panels.

lena-ops: I can create the Zoom + recording settings and set registration so we track attendees. Do we want to cap live breakout groups at 6?

emily-po: yup cap at 6 per breakout. Recording + separate APAC session works. Would like to keep live session to 60 min total: 20min rubric walkthrough, 30min mock panels (3 groups x 10min), 10min Q&A.

ravi-recruiter: Draft invite copy below — feel free to edit.

```
Subject: Mandatory Panel Calibration — Wed [date] 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET
Who: All active interviewers + new hires in last 6 months (mandatory); returning panelists (recommended)
Agenda: rubric overview, scoring examples, 3x mock panels, Q&A
Prep: review attached rubric, come with one sample question
RSVP: register via the Zoom link below
```

lena-ops: can you attach the rubric doc and a 5-question quiz link? I can collect completion via Google Form and tag in People Ops sheet.

emily-po: yes I'll attach rubric v2 (see comments from hiring managers). Quiz should be <10 min. If someone scores 80% they can skip the live mock panels.

caleb-hr-bot: Calendar event created: "Panel Calibration Workshop — Live (Recording + APAC repeat)" Wed [date] 10:00am PT. Link: https://zoom.example/abc123.

julia-peopleops: small ask: can we include a short sample feedback template for panelists to use? That helped standardize language.

tom-eng: also add a short "edge cases" slide: senior IC vs manager differences, ambiguous answers, and red flags. 1 slide each.

emily-po: action items: (1) emily — finalize rubric + quiz by EOD Fri; (2) lena — set up registration + collect attendance; (3) ravi — send invite to panelists + reminders; (4) tom/julia — prepare mock scenarios and feedback template. Will follow up with final agenda and links. Thanks all :raised_hands:

ravi-recruiter: quick question — do we award a "certified panelist" tag in Slack/profile after folks complete? That would help hiring managers route interviews.

emily-po: yes plan to add a profile tag in Slack and a column in Greenhouse once we confirm criteria (quiz pass or attend live + mock).

lena-ops: created registration form; I'll share results in #people-ops later today.

caleb-hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24h before event for those registered.

julia-peopleops: great — i'll draft the feedback template and upload it to the shared drive. Will ping when done.

emily-po: perfect. If no blockers I'll publish the invite in ~30min. Thanks team! :calendar:
